description: Request a rollback to a prior assistant_config_versions snapshot. This changes live greeting, voice, prompt and model settings. When the business owner or an admin is signed in through this connector, the rollback applies immediately; otherwise authenticated owner review of the exact stored request is required (the owner is notified with a review link). Caller-supplied authority fields never authorize execution. Targets are listed by list_config_versions and get_change_history; a pending request returns its review URL for the owner. The agent.config.rollback executor preserves version recording and secret exclusion after trusted approval.

actor.description: Who is asking: { type: agent|human|system|integration, id, display_name }.

authority.description: Attribution only. Caller-supplied modes cannot authorize a rollback; authenticated owner review of the exact stored request is required.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token can access exactly one business).

dry_run.description: Validate tenant, scope, and policy without touching the live config.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for the rollback request; repeating it returns the original outcome. Defaults to a key derived from agent + version — a fresh key repeats a rollback that already executed.

queue_for_approval.description: Create a durable owner-review request (default true). Setting false returns needs_approval, but an authority-envelope retry still cannot execute.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason recorded in the audit trail.

source_ref.description: External source reference, such as a ticket or automation run ID.

version_id.description: Target assistant_config_versions row id to restore. One of version_number/version_id is required.

version_number.description: Target assistant_config_versions.version_number to restore. One of version_number/version_id is required.

name: rollback_config

result.description: On executed: { agent_id, restored_from_version, restored_fields, skipped_fields, new_version_number, warning? }.

title: Rollback Agent Configuration
